title: हिन्दी साहित्य अभ्यास सेट 1 (इतिहास एवं आदिकाल — 25Q)

questions.source: BPSC Teacher TGT Hindi - Advt. 23/2023 | इतिहास-लेखन परंपरा
questions.en: What is the name of the four-volume work written by the early historians of Hindi literature, Mishrabandhu?
questions.hi: हिन्दी साहित्य के प्रारंभिक इतिहासकार मिश्रबंधुओं द्वारा लिखित चार खंडों की रचना का क्या नाम है?
options: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: 'Mishrabandhu-Vinod' composed by the Mishrabandhus (Ganeshbihari, Shyamabihari and Shukdevbihari Mishra) was published in four parts (the first three parts in 1913 AD and the fourth part in 1934 AD). The chronicles of about 5,000 poets are compiled in it.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: 'Mishrabandhu-Vinod' composed by the Mishrabandhus (Ganeshbihari, Shyamabihari and Shukdevbihari Mishra) was published in four parts (the first three parts in 1913 AD and the fourth part in 1934 AD). The chronicles of about 5,000 poets are compiled in it.

questions.source: BPSC Teacher TGT Hindi - Advt. 23/2023 | आदिकाल - रासो साहित्य
questions.en: Whose composition is the ancient 'Prithviraj Raso'?

options: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: The author of 'Prithviraj Raso' is Chandbardai, who is considered by Acharya Ramchandra Shukla as the first great poet of Hindi and 'Prithviraj Raso' is considered the first epic of Hindi.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक

questions.source: BPSC Teacher TGT Hindi - Advt. 23/2023 | काल-विभाजन एवं नामकरण
questions.en: Who named the initial period of Hindi literature as 'Adikal'?
questions.hi: हिन्दी साहित्य के प्रारंभिक काल का 'आदिकाल' नामकरण किसने किया?
options: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: The name 'Adikaal' was given to the initial period by Acharya Hazari Prasad Dwivedi, which was universally accepted. Acharya Shukla called it 'Veergatha Kaal' (primordial period).
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक

questions.source: BPSC Teacher TGT Hindi - Advt. 23/2023 | भक्तिकाल - समय-सीमा
questions.en: According to Acharya Ramchandra Shukla, what is considered to be the time limit of Bhakti period?
questions.hi: आचार्य रामचंद्र शुक्ल के अनुसार भक्तिकाल की समय-सीमा क्या मानी गई है?
options: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation: Acharya Shukla divided the period into eras: Adikaal (heroic period) = 1050 to 1375; Pre-medieval period (Bhakti period) = 1375 to 1700; Answer: Medieval period (Ritikal) = 1700 to 1900; Modern period = 1900 to 1984.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक

questions.en: “One's own language is progress, the root of all progress. Without knowledge of one's own language, nothing can be lost." Whose statement is this?
questions.hi: “निज भाषा उन्नति अहै, सब उन्नति को मूल। बिन निज भाषा ज्ञान के, मिटे न हिय को सूल॥” यह किसका कथन है?

questions.explanation: Bharatendu Harishchandra, the father of modern Hindi literature, in his famous essay/lecture 'Lecture on the Progress of Hindi' had described the progress of the mother tongue as the basic basis of all progress.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
